6,8.name: Weathered Shed Door
6,8.dialogue: A heavy brass padlock seals the shed. Whatever garden tools or forgotten drafts rest inside are kept well away from the rain.

12,6.name: Mossy Gravestone
12,6.dialogue: Velvet moss has nearly swallowed the epitaph. Only a weathered colophon glyph remains legible beneath the lichen.
